decisions.claim: B works at the same office as A
decisions.reason: A uses the definite 'the office' in turn 3, presupposing shared knowledge of a specific workplace between A and B. Combined with 'we are having' (a party A organizes) and 'many coming from the office,' the most natural presupposition is that B works at the same office as A.
decisions.counterexample: B might merely know about A's office through other social connections without working there, but the definite shared reference and party context make same-office the strongest presupposition.
